test_secfpn: test the SECONDFPN neck module by building it with a config dict and asserting channel and stride properties
build_secfpn_neck: build a SECONDFPN neck using mmdet build_neck with in_channels, upsample_strides, and out_channels config
test_secfpn_mismatched_strides: test that building a SECONDFPN neck with mismatched upsample_strides and in_channels raises an AssertionError
test_secfpn_mismatched_out_channels: test that building a SECONDFPN neck with mismatched upsample_strides and out_channels raises an AssertionError
review_test_secfpn: review the test_secfpn function to verify SECONDFPN neck construction and assertion error handling for invalid configs
